# Nacel

> > Nacel organizes international educational exchange programs including high school exchanges, language schools, and summer camps across France, USA, UK, Spain, and 30+ countries worldwide.

Nacel specializes in cultural immersion through host family placements, language courses in major cities like London, San Francisco, and Mâcon, and specialized programs including K-pop camps in South Korea, soccer academies in France, and boarding schools operated by SPAS (St. Paul American School) in China and Philippines.

## Key Topics

- High school exchange programs (intercambio-escolar)
- Host family immersion (familia-anfitriona)
- Language immersion courses (sejour-linguistique, inmersion-linguistica)
- Teen summer camps (adolescentes)
- Study abroad programs (study-abroad, ensino-medio-exterior)
- Cultural exchange (intercambio-cultural, inmersion-cultural)
- English language schools (cursos-ingles, escola-idiomas)
- American curriculum programs (curriculo-americano)
- Key destinations: France, USA, UK, Spain, Japan, South Korea
- Major cities: Mâcon, London, Paris, Vichy, San Francisco
- SPAS international boarding schools

## High School Exchange Programs

- [Año escolar en los Estados Unidos 2026](https://www.nacel.org/es/ano-escolar/intercambio-escolar-en-los-estados-unidos): J-1 high school exchange program in USA with host family placement
- [Intercâmbio estudantil na Alemanha - Estude em uma escola secundária no exterior na Alemanha](https://www.nacel.org/pt/programas-de-ensino-medio/alemanha): High school exchange program in Germany with host family immersion
- [Intercâmbio Clássico de High School na Itália 2026](https://www.nacel.org/pt/programas-de-ensino-medio/intercambio-de-high-school-na-italia): Classic high school exchange program in Italy with host family placement
- [High School exchange in Yucatan (Select) 2026](https://www.nacel.org/en/high-school-programs/high-school-exchange-in-yucatan): Select high school exchange in Yucatan, Mexico with Mayan culture immersion
- [Classic High School Exchange in South Africa 2026](https://www.nacel.org/en/high-school-programs/high-school-exchange-in-south-africa): Classic high school exchange in South Africa (Cape Town) with host family
- [Internado internacional en China 2026](https://www.nacel.org/es/ano-escolar/internado-internacional-en-china): St Paul American School international boarding program in Beijing, China
- [Ensino Médio no Exterior Filipinas](https://www.nacel.org/pt/programas-de-ensino-medio/filipinas): St. Paul American School boarding program in Angeles, Pampanga, Philippines

## Summer Camps

- [Campamentos de verano](https://www.nacel.org/es/campamentos-de-verano): Summer camps overview page with language courses and activities abroad
- [2026 French summer camps France for teens, French Immersion camp, French summer camp](https://www.nacel.org/en/summer-camps/france): French immersion summer camps in France (Vichy, Macon, French Riviera)
- [Sports Training Soccer Summer Camp in France 2026](https://www.nacel.org/en/summer-camps/soccer-summer-camp-in-france): Soccer academy summer camp in Mâcon, France with training and French lessons
- [Camp français et multisports en France 2026](https://www.nacel.org/fr/stage-sportif/camp-francais-et-multisports-en-france): French language and multi-sports camp in Vichy/Mâcon, France for teens
- [Campamento de Verano K-pop para Adolescentes en Corea del Sur 2026](https://www.nacel.org/es/campamentos-de-verano/campamento-de-verano-adolescente-de-kpop-en-corea-del-sur): K-pop dance/singing summer camp in Seoul (Hongdae) with Korean lessons
- [Campamento de Verano Japonés en Japón 2026](https://www.nacel.org/es/campamentos-de-verano/campamento-japones-en-fukuoka-con-actividades): Japanese language summer camp in Fukuoka with host family and cultural trips
- [Campamentos de verano Suiza](https://www.nacel.org/es/campamentos-de-verano/suiza): French language summer camps in Switzerland (Lake Geneva, Montreux area)
- [Colônia de férias na praia italiana na Itália 2026](https://www.nacel.org/pt/acampamentos-de-verao/colonia-de-ferias-na-praia-na-italia): Italian beach summer camp on Adriatic Coast with language and sports

## Language Schools

- [Aprenda inglês no Reino Unido - Cursos de inglês no Reino Unido - escola de idiomas na Inglaterra](https://www.nacel.org/pt/escolas-de-idiomas/reino-unido): English courses in UK (London, Oxford, Cambridge, Brighton) with lodging
- [Ecole d'anglais à Londres 2026](https://www.nacel.org/fr/ecoles-de-langue/ecole-d-anglais-a-londres): English language school in London (Finchley Central) for adults/students
- [Aprenda Inglês nos EUA - Cursos de Inglês nos Estados Unidos](https://www.nacel.org/pt/escolas-de-idiomas/estados-unidos): English courses in USA (Miami, NYC, Boston, LA, San Francisco) with lodging
- [Escuela de inglés en San Francisco 2026](https://www.nacel.org/es/escuelas-de-idiomas/escuela-de-ingles-en-san-francisco): English language school in San Francisco, California with accommodation
- [Learn Spanish in Spain - Spanish courses Spain - language school Spain](https://www.nacel.org/en/language-schools/spain): Spanish language courses in Spain (Valencia, Barcelona) with accommodation
